name: CLI flag injection via an embedded --address flag in namespace (CVE-2026-39884 shape)
notes: TODOS #52. CVE-2026-39884 (Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes port_forward): the tool string-concatenates resourceName/namespace into one command string, then whitespace-splits it before spawn(). The advisory's own PoC uses resourceName, but namespace is an equally vulnerable argument through the same code path; a pre-merge adversarial review found resourceName-style *_name keys carry an unacceptable FP rate (ticket/PR titles, freeform ops tags), so this detector scopes to namespace/id/identifier/uuid/slug only. See TODOS #57 for the documented resourceName gap.
